kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تستشهدون (form X)
# تَسْتَشْهِدُونَ (tastašhidūna) /tas.taʃ.hi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# تُسْتَشْهَدُونَ (tustašhadūna) /tus.taʃ.ha.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
